text:
samir: Quick sync request 10:00 PT tomorrow with partners to nail down marketplace lead times and the H100/H200/B200 + MI300/Gaudi handoff plan. Can we make it?

lena: Ican do it. Need to confirm if the partner embargo overlaps with our release candidate validation window.

oliver: FYI runtime note: our H200 optimized kernels are green but H100 microcode depends on vendor firmware drop. That might shift H100 GA into late-May if firmware misses the test gate.

samir: Noted. Helen, can you coordinate SI integrator readiness and ensure we have a test image for Gaudi?

helen: On it. Integrators asked for a staging image + compatibility matrix by EOW. I'll push a Gaudi staging image to the internal registry and tag it gaudi-staging-20260511.

devops-bot: Deploy bot: image gaudi-staging-20260511 pushed to registry (sha256:abcdef123456).

lena: Marketplace checklist reminder: each cloud wants final image tag, SHA, test account, and an accepted SLA doc. I'll open cloud tickets after partner sync.

samir: Proposed fallback mapping for hosted API: primary H100, fallback H200, grace fallback B200-quant. If H100 slips past GA, auto-route H100 traffic to H200 for latency SLOs.

oliver: I'll prepare perf deltas between H100/H200/B200-quant and share numbers. Expect 1015% throughput gap H200->H100 depending on sequence length.

helen: Integrator note: SI needs API contract compatibility tests for function-calling. I'll include sample prompts and test harness.

samir: Action items:
- @lena open cloud marketplace tickets per provider with lead times
- @oliver post perf matrix and candidate image tags
- @helen push Gaudi staging image + compat matrix
- @samir consolidate canonical timeline and embargo windows and circulate to partners

lena: I'll aim to have tickets and ETA by Tue 2026-05-12 EOD.

oliver: Perf matrix will be in #eng-runtime by Wed 2026-05-13.

helen: Gaudi staging tagged and pushed. I'll DM integrators to run compatibility tests this week.

samir: Invite created for partner sync 2026-05-14 10:00 PT. Meeting link in calendar. :calendar:

lena: One more ask: communications should include contingency language for press and partner portals if GA dates drift. We should get comms legal eyes on embargo wording.

samir: Agreed. I'll loop in comms & legal after we have firm dates. Thanks everyone.
